instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: But when I think about being the writer, things become much harder. I might ask AI to fix a phrase or help me think about what happens in the story, but how much can I use it and still proudly say, I wrote this? Where is the line between a helpful partner I can talk with and someone who writes with me? So it would be a shame to make this prize only a simple question, is AI good or bad? A prize that chooses stories also shows what the people choosing them value. The question of whether AI was used does not end the discussion. Instead, it becomes the starting point for reading. It seems writers are not the only people being tested at this new entrance. So how will we read that book?
